title: Authentication
body: Use a project-scoped API token in the Authorization Bearer header. Rotate tokens every 90 days. Never put tokens in a URL.

title: Rate limits
body: The standard plan allows 120 requests per minute per project. A 429 response includes Retry-After in seconds. Honor Retry-After before retrying.

title: Pagination
body: List responses include next_cursor. Pass next_cursor as cursor in the next request. A null next_cursor means there are no more pages.

title: Deletion
body: Delete requests are asynchronous and return 202. Poll the deletion job until complete. Deleted documents remain in backups for 30 days.

title: Access control
body: Retrieval enforces the requesting user access permissions. A connector token does not grant users additional access. Refresh permission mappings daily.

title: Versioning
body: Only approved current documents enter retrieval. Superseded versions remain available in the audit archive and are excluded from normal search.

title: Citations
body: Answers must include document ID and version for each factual claim. If supporting sources conflict, flag the conflict and route to an owner.

title: Uploads
body: Supported file types are PDF, Markdown, and plain text. The maximum file size is 20 MB. Encrypted PDFs are rejected.

title: Retry behavior
body: Retry transient 503 errors with exponential backoff and jitter. Make at most three attempts. Never retry a 401 without correcting credentials.

title: Privacy
body: Logs must redact API tokens and email addresses. Retain application logs for 14 days. Restrict log access to authorized operators.
